snippet.title: Resident Evil 0 Zero - PS1 DEMAKE - Mod of Resident Evil 2
snippet.description:
Mod created by @elrincondellobezno6726 @BiohazardEsp @3lric @Resevilnemesis30 @SerchBoogie @AndrewCoyte and Rusty

DOWNLOAD available on the author's channel:
Here: https://youtu.be/i-ytBE7YWsI
Or here: https://www.youtube.com/live/NkKG5Zmf3ZM?feature=share

This is a Resident Evil 2 mod that turns the game into Resident Evil 0 Zero for PS1. It's still a demo and it's only possible to play the first part of the game.
